sentences.text: Through: Mr. Rahul Sharma & Mr. Kshi  Goel, Advocates.

versus  STATE NCT OF DELHI ..
 Through: Mr. Utkarsh, APP

for  with SI Virendere   Raj Kumar, Narcoti  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 15.02.2024 1.
It is pointed out that the applicant was convicted in FIR No. 58/2010, registered at Police Station Bhalswa Dairy, for offences under Sections 376/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. In such circumstances, it appears that while the sentence awarded to the applicant in FIR No.
58/2010 was suspended, he further indulged in offences which resulted in registration of other FIRs against him in 2016, 2019, 2022 and also the present FIR in 2023, that is FIR No.308/2023.

3. Let the nominal roll of the applicant, in relation to FIR No. 58/2010, be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.
4.
5. A copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for compliance.
6. Interim orders to continue, subject to the applicant joining and cooperating with the investigation.

AMIT MAHAJAN, J FEBRUARY 15, 2024/"hkaur"
